title: Inline adds double parens around already-parenthesized expressions
description: When inlining a = (1 + 2) used as 'test(a * 3)', produces 'test(((1 + 2)) * 3)' instead of 'test((1 + 2) * 3)'. The outer parens of the rhs are included in replace_code and then another layer is added by the parens logic.
close_reason: Fixed: already-parenthesized expressions no longer double-wrapped during inline

title: Add edge case tests for rename refactoring
description: Cover: decorator references, comprehension scopes, f-string references, type annotations, __all__ lists, star imports, walrus operator targets

title: Expand refactoring test coverage for untested Python constructs
description: Systematic expansion of test coverage across all 4 refactoring operations (inline, extract_variable, extract_function, rename) for Python constructs that are currently untested. Based on gap analysis comparing jedi's tests against rope, JetBrains/PyCharm, and academic research.
close_reason: All 19 gap tests added and passing. Total test count now 169 (up from 150).

title: Add f-string tests across all refactoring operations
description: f-strings are untested in all 4 operations. Rename should update vars inside f-strings. Inline should substitute into f-strings. Extract variable currently errors on fstring_start (known bug jedi-czz). Test: rename var in f-string, inline var used in f-string, extract f-string as variable.
close_reason: Added fstring-var rename and inline tests

title: Add nonlocal/global declaration tests
description: nonlocal and global are untested in all 4 operations. Rename with nonlocal should update all scope references. Extract function with nonlocal must propagate the declaration. Inline involving global vars needs testing.

title: Add async/await tests across refactoring operations
description: async def, await, async for, async with are untested. Rename of async functions, extract from async body, inline in async context. Extract function containing await should produce async def.
close_reason: Added async-function rename and async-await-bug extract_function tests

title: Add except-as and exception handling scope tests
description: Python 3 implicitly deletes the except-as variable after the handler. Rename of except-as binding, extract from except body, inline involving exception vars. Also test except* (3.11+) if supported by parso.

title: Add comprehension scope tests
description: Comprehension variables have their own scope in Python 3. Rename inner comprehension variable, extract from comprehension body, inline var used in comprehension. Test list, dict, set, and generator comprehensions.

title: Add walrus operator tests beyond error cases
description: Walrus operator currently only tested as error in extract_variable. Add: rename walrus-bound variable, inline var defined by walrus, extract function with walrus in condition.

title: Add import-as aliasing tests
description: import x as y and from x import y as z are untested in all operations. Rename should update the alias and all references. Inline involving aliased imports needs testing.

title: Add untested literal and syntax tests
description: Several literal types untested: set literals, bytes, multiline strings, raw strings, ellipsis, complex numbers. Also: with multiple context managers, for-else, while loop, assert, raise, del.
close_reason: Added set/bytes/ellipsis/raw-string/generator tests and for-loop/with-as rename tests

title: Remove duplicate test for-something
description: for-something in extract_variable.py is byte-for-byte identical to for-param-1. Already removed in working tree, needs to be committed and pushed.

title: Add edge case tests for inline refactoring
description: Cover: multiple references across scopes, walrus operator, f-strings, nested scopes, starred expressions, await expressions, multiline strings

title: Implement Introduce Parameter refactoring (Core 6)
description: Add introduce_parameter to jedi's refactoring toolkit. Takes a variable/expression inside a function and promotes it to a parameter, updating all call sites.

title: Add edge case tests for extract_function refactoring
description: Cover: async functions, nested classes, global/nonlocal statements, try/except blocks, with statements, comprehensions in extracted code

title: extract_variable walrus operator gives unhelpful error message
description: Extracting (y := 3) gives 'Cannot extract a namedexpr_test' which exposes parser internals. Should say something like 'Cannot extract a walrus/assignment expression'.
close_reason: Improved error messages: namedexpr_test→walrus operator, fstring_start→f-string

title: extract_function from async body produces non-async function
description: When extracting an expression containing await from an async function, the extracted function is created as a regular def (not async def) and the call site omits await. The extracted code will fail at runtime since await is used outside async context. Rope handles this by making the extracted function async.

title: Add edge case tests for extract_variable refactoring
description: Cover: walrus operator, comprehensions, decorator expressions, await, starred expressions, multiline expressions, chained comparisons

title: extract_variable cannot extract f-strings
description: Attempting to extract an f-string raises RefactoringError: Cannot extract a fstring_start. The fstring type is not in _VARIABLE_EXCTRACTABLE list. This is a limitation users may encounter.

title: extract_variable cannot extract ellipsis literal
description: Pointing at ... in 'y = ...' and extracting gives 'Cannot extract a expr_stmt' error. Other literals (None, True, False, integers, strings) work fine. The ellipsis constant should be extractable.
close_reason: Fixed: ellipsis (...) operator now allowed in extract_variable

title: Inline adds unnecessary parens around simple literals
description: When inlining x = 42 in 'return x + 1', produces 'return (42) + 1' instead of 'return 42 + 1'. The parens are added because tree_name.parent.type is in EXPRESSION_PARTS (arith_expr), but a simple literal doesn't need wrapping.
close_reason: Fixed: simple literals no longer wrapped in parens during inline

title: rename with nonlocal doesn't update nonlocal declaration or outer scope
description: When renaming a variable that has a nonlocal declaration, jedi renames the assignment and local uses but does NOT update: (1) the nonlocal x declaration itself, (2) references in the outer scope (e.g., return x). This produces broken code. Discovered during probe testing. Rope handles this correctly.

title: Implement Introduce Field refactoring (Core 6)
description: Add introduce_field to jedi's refactoring toolkit. Takes a local variable/expression inside a method and promotes it to an instance field (self.x), updating callers.
